text:
leah (PM): Published the incident brief for last night's slowdowns: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/1768000000-errant-cache-brief. TL;DR: cache eviction cascade + sudden autoscaler bursts caused elevated latencies and some 502s for ~15m.
omar (SRE): Adding timeline notes now. Observed a sharp KV eviction at 02:13 UTC, followed by kernel swap activity.
devin (Eng): I pulled the flame graphs and a few model hosts hit an unexpected memory pressure pattern. I'm attaching screenshot to the doc.
maya (QA): We'll add a short regression for small-sequence perf and run it in the canary gate. Estimate: 1 day.
leah (PM): Key follow-ups (owner -> due): 1) lower autoscaler burst cap -> @omar (due 2026-04-02). 2) add soft-alert on cache-evictions (>20% in 5m) -> @devin (due 2026-04-05). 3) runbook tweak for forced failover -> @omar (due 2026-04-01). 4) add smoke test to CI for short sequences -> @maya (due 2026-04-04).
odar-bot: (typo in name) -- ignore
omar (SRE): Ack. I've already queued the runbook change and will start the autoscaler change in the staging pool first.
devin (Eng): I'll add dashboard panels for eviction rate + per-host mem pressure, and a playbook note about rolling restarts.
support-bot: Customer notifications: templates updated in the doc under "communications". Top impacted accounts were messaged.
leah (PM): Scheduling a 30m follow-up to review progress and close items: Thu 2026-04-02 09:00 PT. Invite sent. If you can't make it, drop updates in the doc and react with :white_check_mark: when you begin your task.
maya (QA): Will post test PR today.
devin (Eng): I'll add checkboxes in the owners table.
leah (PM): Thanks all. I'll mark this thread resolved once all checkboxes are checked and the follow-up sync confirms closure.
_meta: postmortem announcement thread: incident brief link, owners, due dates, follow-up sync. Unique wording; avoids repeating existing filenames.
